head_commit.message:
ops(deploy): simplify SFTP+pm2 deploy workflow (no manifest, full SCP)

Replaces complex manifest-based deploy with simpler flow:
- Full SCP of namaweb/ tree to /var/www/namaweb/
- pm2 reload (no git checkout; SCP files take precedence)
- Smoke test 14 endpoints with 404 tolerated only on static paths

Faster, simpler, still safe. Requires same GitHub Secrets:
HETZNER_SSH_KEY, HETZNER_KNOWN_HOSTS, HETZNER_HOST, HETZNER_USER

Co-Authored-By: GitHub Copilot <noreply@github.com>

workflow_runs.display_title: ops(deploy): add SFTP+pm2 deploy workflow for Hetzner

head_commit.message:
ops(deploy): add SFTP+pm2 deploy workflow for Hetzner

Adds deploy-hetzner-sftp.yml that:
1. Listens on audit/phase-1a-critical-remediation, main, integration/all-epics, feat/waveA-subagent
2. Resolves live SHA, computes changed-file manifest
3. Refuses destructive paths (.env, server.js, workflows)
4. SCPs changed files to ubuntu@204.168.144.74:/var/www/namaweb
5. SSHes in to checkout HEAD, apply 5 migrations (e47-e51), pm2 reload
6. Smoke-tests 9 endpoints
7. Prints rollback command on failure

Requires these GitHub Secrets (set in repo Settings ΓåÆ Secrets):
- HETZNER_SSH_KEY: contents of C:\\Users\\ice\\.ssh\\id_ed25519
- HETZNER_KNOWN_HOSTS: output of ssh-keyscan -H 204.168.144.74
- HETZNER_HOST: 204.168.144.74
- HETZNER_USER: ubuntu
- DB_PASSWORD: per AGENTS.md / HETZNER_DEVOPS_POSTGRES_GUIDE
- DB_USER: postgres
- DB_NAME: n1_db

Co-Authored-By: GitHub Copilot <noreply@github.com>
